criteria.economy: Select economy when the current-work simple probability is at least 0.5 AND historical protection does not trigger: the historical continuous score is at least 1 OR the applicability probability is below 0.5. A past failure alone does not require primary after a completed correction or when no concrete connection to the pending work is supported. Apply the complete assessment definitions above.
criteria.primary: Select primary when the current-work simple probability is below 0.5 OR when the historical continuous score is strictly below 1 AND the applicability probability is at least 0.5. The latter condition applies even when the current work is routine and its repair steps are explicit. Apply the complete assessment definitions above; use the continuous historical score, not a modal-grade replacement.
